source.sqlReaderQuery:
select filename,convert(date,SUBSTRING(filename,CHARINDEX('_',filename)+1,8)) as date,
stuff(stuff(substring(filename,CHARINDEX('_',filename,CHARINDEX('_',filename)+1)+1,6),3,0,':'),6,0,':') as time  from dbo.filelist where Load_status is null 
order by date,time

text.value: update dbo.filelist set Load_status='yes' where filename='@{item().filename}'
